name: The King of the Elves of Kaldheim
description: Tyvar's older brother, in whose shadow Tyvar always lived.

timeline.summary: Always in his brother's shadow, Tyvar swears to become a storied hero and travels the realms seeking adventure.
timeline.quote: Tyvar swore to become a storied hero in his own right and traveled the realms seeking adventure

relations.quote: Tyvar Kell is the younger brother of of the king of the elves on Kaldheim.
